t: That section 2 of the Act of May 22, 1965, 79 Stat. 117, is amended by striking out “June 30, 1966” and substituting in lieu thereof “June 30, 1971”.

fable.w: This section only extends a date in an earlier Act by replacing one deadline with another. There is no tempting reading here: it mentions no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue involving anyone outside the federal government. Whatever the underlying 1965 Act provides, this text itself creates no outside-party process.
fable.s: is amended by striking out “June 30, 1966” and substituting in lieu thereof “June 30, 1971”
